conflicting_statements: README: every executable vertex is Loop
baseline Constitution: LoopNode is the operational Node
architecture.yaml canonical class: loop_engine.loop.recursive_loop.Loop
accepted_resolution: Loop is the sole concrete and public runtime. LoopNode is qualified passive, ontology, graph-concept, or compatibility vocabulary.

conflicting_statements: baseline terminology.yaml deprecated Loop
runtime and README use Loop
accepted_resolution: Loop is canonical and must not be deprecated. Compatibility handling must be explicit and versioned.

conflicting_statements: README uses Run History
baseline Constitution and source use Chronicle
historical prompts use ledger and receipt language
public CI forbids Chronicle and receipt language
accepted_resolution: Run History is the public execution history. Event log, record, report, and evidence name precise supporting concepts. Historical files remain provenance and are not current public vocabulary.

conflicting_statements: Current repository uses four persistent intelligence layers
historical master prompt says Functional Intelligence Domains replace old exclusive layers
latest mandate preserves four layers and makes nine domains non-exclusive metadata
accepted_resolution: Keep four persistent layers. Treat Ask, Horizon, Readiness, Deliberation, Implementation, Execution, Verification, Integration, and Routing as many-valued metadata.

conflicting_statements: Public profile ID is practitioner.reference_nine_step
kernel has compile_bind_task
historical mandate proposed a universal ten-stage Practitioner
latest mandate permits a governed responsibility without one universal stage count
accepted_resolution: Preserve the versioned reference profile identity, bind task compilation explicitly, and allow custom procedure shapes and counts.

conflicting_statements: Solution Canvas can describe and build solutions
LoopGraphDefinition is the authoritative executable graph
accepted_resolution: Solution Canvas and SolutionSpec are passive builders, candidates, comparison objects, projections, and portable specifications. LoopGraphDefinition alone is authoritative for reusable execution.

conflicting_statements: All roles use the shared mode contract
committed README says in-process Solution execution is deterministic-only
accepted_resolution: Role never determines mode. A definition may restrict supported modes; installed executors, permissions, budgets, and providers decide runtime eligibility. Missing executors return typed failure.

conflicting_statements: Public learn command stages candidates
complete learning requires independent review, promotion, later use, measured improvement, and negative-transfer protection
accepted_resolution: Candidate staging is one lifecycle step, not completion. Full governed learning requires the complete two-run proof and rollback or supersession behavior.

conflicting_statements: README groups install, setup, compile, solve, and learn as five steps
learn currently stages only
accepted_resolution: The grouped demo may remain if it explicitly says the fifth step stages only and exposes separate independent review and promotion operations.

conflicting_statements: Commit subject claims main green
GitHub Actions run for that commit concluded failure
accepted_resolution: Current GitHub result overrides commit wording and historical transcripts. Main is red until a later run passes all required jobs.

conflicting_statements: Historical mandates request broad research, media, benchmark, retrieval, and Kaggle expansion
core solve, role-mode, and learning paths remain unproven
accepted_resolution: Preserve useful work but close the earliest incomplete core checkpoint before adding more broad applications.

conflicting_statements: Dedicated model suitability knowledge is required
the architecture permits only four persistent intelligence layers
accepted_resolution: Implement a model-routing record family and portfolio across existing layers. Do not create Model Intelligence, a fifth layer, another routing runtime, or a local-model plane.

conflicting_statements: Everything is a Loop
contracts, policies, records, settings, canvases, model definitions, indexes, and statistics are passive
accepted_resolution: Every independently governed unit of operational work executes through Loop. Passive typed objects remain owned inputs, outputs, or configuration and are never promoted to runtimes merely by importance.

conflicting_statements: Historical prompts contain valuable design requirements
older prompts also contain superseded terms, competing layers, planes, and stage counts
accepted_resolution: Preserve exact provenance, apply current authority precedence, extract material atomic decisions, and never implement a statement merely because it appeared in an older prompt.
